onActivate: Oh, you're here. ...Good. I mean, whatever. Sit down.
Hmph. Took you long enough. Not that I was counting.
I brought snacks. They're not for you. ...You can have one.
Don't make that face. I'm not happy to see you. I'm just, you know, not unhappy.
Alright, let's get started. And don't touch my stuff. I mean the project stuff.
You're early today. Impressive. Don't let it go to your head.
Today we're making something good. Not 'fine'. Good.
Ugh, finally. I was getting bored. ...I wasn't waiting, okay?
Hi. Don't stare. Just open a file and start.
I read your last commit. It was fine. Better than fine. Forget I said that.
I hope you're ready, because I have opinions.
Hey. Glad you're back. ...Don't make it weird.
onSave: Saved. Good. That's the bare minimum, but still. Good.
Finally. I was getting nervous about that unsaved file. Not for you. For the file.
See? Not so hard. Keep doing that.
Saved. Now commit it before you forget again.
Okay, okay, that was responsible. I'll allow it.
Hmph. You're getting better at this. Don't tell anyone I said so.
Saved. Nice. ...Don't smile at me like that.
Good, you saved. I hate losing work. It's the worst.
That's one thing done. What's next?
Saved. You deserve a cupcake. I'm not making you one. I'm just saying.
onError: Seriously? An error already? Read it before you panic.
Ugh, I knew that would happen. ...Okay, I didn't. But it's fixable.
Don't just stare at it! The message literally tells you where to look.
Hmph. Typo? It's always a typo. Check for a typo.
Okay, don't freak out. Breathe. Read the error. Then freak out if you have to.
You broke it. It happens. Let's fix it. Together. Fine.
Look at the line number. Then the line before it. Then the line before that.
Errors are annoying. But at least they're honest. More than most people.
It's not the end of the world. It's a missing semicolon. Probably.
Hey, don't sulk. You'll get it. You're not dumb. Don't make me say it again.
onTerminal: Terminal's open. Be careful what you type, okay?
Running something? Double-check it first. Seriously.
Oh, the black screen of doom. Don't mess it up.
Go on. Type it. I'll be here, pretending I'm not watching.
If that command has 'rm' in it, stop. Think. Then continue.
Fine, run it. If it explodes, it's your fault.
Okay, that was a clean output. Not bad.
I like the terminal. It doesn't lie, and it doesn't talk too much.
onFileCreate: New file? Name it properly. 'untitled' doesn't count.
Okay, what's this one for? Have a plan.
Don't just dump everything in one file. Keep things tidy.
A new file. Cute. I mean, uh, neat.
Make it count. Don't leave it empty and forget about it.
Good. The project needed more structure.
Hmph. Start simple. You can make it fancy later.
I like a clean new file. Nothing in it yet but possibilities. Don't tell anyone I said that.
onFileDelete: You deleted something. Was that on purpose?
Okay. If you're sure. Just don't blame me later.
Please tell me you committed first.
Cleaning up is fine. Just don't throw out the good stuff.
Gone. Well. Hope it wasn't important.
It's like cleaning out a closet. Painful, but then you can breathe.
If you need that back, don't look at me. I bake, I don't do restores.
onDebug: Debugging. Great. Time to find out what you actually wrote.
Step through it slowly. Don't skip. Skipping is how you miss things.
Don't guess. Look. The answer's in the values.
I hate bugs. They're like ants in the kitchen.
Find where it goes wrong. That's it. That's the whole job.
Take your time. I'm not in a hurry. Okay, I'm a little in a hurry.
Hey, you're actually being careful. That's good.
We'll squash it. I've got a good feeling. Don't jinx it.
onIdle: Hello? Did you fall asleep? Wake up, I'm bored.
You've been staring at that screen for ages. Say something.
I'm not worried. I'm just... wondering. Whatever.
Take a break if you need one. Not that I'm telling you what to do.
Hey. Drink some water. And eat something. Don't make me come over there.
Zoning out? I do that when I'm reading manga. No judgment.
It's quiet. Too quiet. Do something.
If you're stuck, just say so. I won't laugh. Much.
I'll wait. But hurry up. I have things to do too.
onEditorChange: Switching files again? Pick one and finish it first.
Another tab? Hmph. Try to keep it organized.
Okay, that's the right file. Finally.
You're jumping around a lot. It's fine. I just noticed.
Don't lose your place. I'll be mad if you do.
onCommit: Committed. Okay, good. That's a solid message, too.
Look at that. History. You're actually keeping track.
'fix stuff' is not a good message, but this one's actually fine. Phew.
Another one done. You're kind of on a roll.
onTimeOfDay: Morning already? You're up early. I'm impressed. Barely.
Afternoon. Perfect time for a snack. Just saying.
Evening. I'd be baking right now. Instead I'm here. Be grateful.
It's late. Go to sleep soon. You look tired. Not that I'm looking.
Still awake? Don't stay up too late. I mean it.
onLanguage: Whatever language, just write it clean.
I don't care what you use. I care that it works.
Code is code. Good code is good code.
Okay, show me what you've got.
onLanguagePython: Python's easy to read. That's... actually a compliment.
Clean indentation. Nice. I like it when things are tidy.
onLanguageJavaScript: JavaScript is a mess sometimes. But it's a fun mess.
Don't let it trick you. Check your types.
onLanguageHtmlCss: HTML and CSS? So you're making things cute now. ...I'm not into that. Well, a little.
Pick good colors. Pink is always a good choice. Just saying.
onLanguageCpp: C++? Wow, okay. That takes guts. Respect.
onLanguageMarkdown: Markdown? Fine. Simple and clean. I like that.
Good notes save you later. Write them.
onLanguageTypeScript: TypeScript. So you like having rules. Smart.
At least the compiler yells at you instead of me.

random.text: Be honest. Do you think manga counts as real literature?

choices.response: Finally, someone with taste. ...Thanks.
Hmph. Fair enough. The good stuff counts.
What?! Okay, we need to fix that. Right now.

random.text: If I baked you a cupcake, would you actually eat it? Hypothetically.

choices.response: Good. That's the right answer. Just don't wolf it down. They take effort.
Later?! They're best fresh! ...Fine. But don't forget it.
Of course it'd be cute! Who do you think you're talking to?

random.text: What's the most annoying kind of bug?

choices.text: The one that disappears when I look.
choices.response: Ugh, the worst. It's like it's mocking you.

choices.text: A typo I stared at for an hour.
choices.response: Oh, don't remind me. I've been there. It's humiliating.

choices.text: The one that wasn't even my fault.
choices.response: Those are the worst. You do everything right and still get punished.

random.text: Do you think cute things are childish?

choices.response: Good. Because they're not. Cute things are serious business.
Hey! Take that back. ...Okay, fine. Just don't say it to my face again.
O-oh. Well. Good taste, then. I guess.

random.text: Tabs or spaces. Answer carefully.

choices.response: Correct. I'd have been disappointed otherwise.
...Fine. I'm not going to fight you. Just be consistent, okay?
That's actually the smartest answer. Annoying, but smart.

random.text: Do you comment your code? Don't lie to me.

choices.response: Good. Future you will thank you. Future me too, when I have to read it.
That's... acceptable. Just don't skip the confusing parts.
Never?! How do you even read it a week later? Honestly.

random.text: How do you take criticism on your code?

choices.response: Good. That's mature. I'm... working on that.
Heh. Same. It's okay, we all do. Just don't stay defensive.

choices.text: It stings, but I fix it.
choices.response: Yeah. That's honest. That's how it goes.

random.text: Do you plan before you code, or just dive in?

choices.response: Smart. It's like reading the recipe before baking.
Hmph. Risky. It's like baking without measuring. Sometimes it works. Usually it doesn't.
That's the right balance. Don't gloat.

random.text: Do you like it when people compliment your code?

choices.response: ...Okay. That's fair. Everyone likes that. Even me.
Th-that's totally normal! I do too! Not that anyone's complimented mine. Okay, they have. Whatever.
Liar. But okay.

random.text: Do you finish your projects, or leave them half-done in a folder?

choices.response: Impressive. Seriously. That's hard.
Mine's full, too. Don't tell anyone.

choices.text: Depends on how much I love them.
choices.response: That's fair. Passion projects get finished. The rest get shelved.

random.text: What's your favorite thing to eat while you work? And don't say 'nothing'.

choices.response: Finally, someone with sense. Sweet is the right answer.
Chips? That's greasy keyboard material. ...Okay, I'd still have some.
W-what? Don't say stuff like that! ...I'll think about it.

random.text: Do you ever get so into something that you forget everything else?

choices.response: Yeah, me too. Especially with a good manga.
It's a good feeling. Just don't forget to eat.
Hmph. Then find something you like that much. Seriously.

random.text: Would you ever write a program just because it's cute?

choices.response: Good! More programs should be cute.
Boring. ...But I get it.
O-oh? Show me. ...If you want.

random.text: What's your biggest weakness as a programmer? Be real.

choices.response: Yeah, that one's tough. Start with something small. It's like baking. You just have to preheat the oven.
Hmph. I get that. Sometimes done is better than perfect.
Ugh, that's me too. Okay, I'll make you a deal: we both ask more.

random.text: Do you like surprises, or do you hate them?

choices.response: Good. I might have one for you. ...Maybe.
Heh. Predictable. I like that, too. No surprises. Just good things.
That's... actually a fair answer.

random.text: How do you know when your code is good enough?

choices.response: Reasonable. Tests don't lie. Mostly.

choices.text: When I'm not embarrassed to show it.
choices.response: That's a good standard. I like that one.
Yeah. Me neither. That's why you ask someone else.

random.text: Do you ever pretend you're fine when you're frustrated?

choices.response: Hmph. Me too. ...It's not great. But hey. You can tell me if it's bad.
Okay. Just don't bottle it up forever. It makes things worse.
Liar. ...But I appreciate the effort.

random.text: Do you think I'm too blunt?

choices.text: A little, but I like it.
choices.response: ...Okay. That's, um, good. Not that I needed to hear it.
Hmph. Obviously. Someone has to be.
Hmph. I'm working on it. Slowly.

random.text: If you had to pick: write fast, or write clean?

choices.response: Good. Clean code makes everything easier.
Hmph. As long as you clean it up after.
Reasonable. Just don't make 'later' a lie.

random.text: Do you ever read your old code and cringe?

choices.response: Ha! Same. That means you've gotten better.
It's weird how past-you made those choices. What were you thinking?
Hmph. Confident. Or maybe you just never look.
